response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), s AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, telescope_count * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes) AS share FROM c), d AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM s) AS diff_from_avg FROM s) SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, diff_from_avg FROM d WHERE diff_from_avg >= (SELECT diff_from_avg FROM d ORDER BY diff_from_avg DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 9) OR (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM d) <= 10 ORDER BY diff_from_avg DESC

assumptions.assumption: Observatories are those appearing in the telescopes table (observatories with no telescopes are excluded), and the average share is taken over those observatories.
Ties at 10th place are detected by exact equality of the computed floating-point difference, which is equivalent to tying on telescope count.
